subject: Housing Stability Notification Ordinance
overview: The subcommittee reviewed and amended a draft ordinance requiring landlords to distribute information on rights and resources to tenants at the start and end of tenancies. The body referred the proposal to the Committee of the Whole pending further legal and financial review of enforcement and fine allocation.

items.title: Draft Housing Stability Notification Ordinance
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed a proposed ordinance based on models from neighboring cities that requires landlords to notify tenants of their rights at the inception and termination of a lease.

items.title: Departmental Feedback on Capacity and Implementation
items.summary: Staff from the Board of Health and the Office of Planning expressed concerns regarding the workload of enforcing the ordinance and suggested prioritizing educational outreach and using city billing cycles for communication.

items.title: Amendments and Referral to Committee of the Whole
items.summary: Approved amendments requiring annual updates to notices and inter-departmental consultation on their creation before referring the draft ordinance to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Requests for Legal and Financial Review
items.summary: Requested legal and financial opinions regarding the city's ability to assess unpaid fines as municipal liens and the feasibility of directing fine revenue into a housing trust or revolving fund.
